cases.mode: Historical replay research prototype - the frozen B2 spread model executes live on stored real ECMWF IFS ENS forecast states; not a live or NCMRWF feed
cases.selection_rule:
(fixed before any demo output was viewed): from the existing 2022 replay set,
the earliest seed-drawn RANDOM case in each season (JF, MAM, JJAS, OND), plus the earliest
existing hidden-bust STRESS case (selected by verification in the v1 replay build; labelled
"not representative").

cases.demo_role: Hidden-bust stress case - selected by verification, NOT representative
cases.selection_note: Hidden-bust stress case: 21 hidden-bust region-days at Day 3-7 (selected by verification only; not representative)

run.mode: Historical replay research prototype - the frozen B2 spread model executes live on stored real ECMWF IFS ENS forecast states; not a live or NCMRWF feed

source.dataset: ECMWF IFS ENS via WeatherBench 2 (64x32 conservative)
source.source_label: ECMWF IFS ENS / ERA5 (historical research archive)

model.estimator: xgboost gradient-boosted trees (CPU hist) + isotonic calibration fitted on validation only
model.calibration: isotonic regression fitted on VALIDATION (2021) predictions only, then frozen
model.alert_threshold_definition: calibrated B2 bust probability giving a 10% false-alarm rate on VALIDATION (2021)
model.target: bust = regional Z500 ensemble-mean RMSE vs ERA5, normalized by the TRAIN anomaly scale, exceeds the TRAIN Q90 for (region, lead day, season)
model.probability_meaning: estimated probability that this region-day's Z500 forecast error exceeds the project-defined large-error (bust) threshold. Not the probability of a weather event, and not a global forecast-quality score.
model.risk_level_definition: ALERT: bust probability >= alert threshold; ABOVE CLIMATOLOGY: above the B0 climatological rate for this region, lead day and season; otherwise AT OR BELOW CLIMATOLOGY. Evidence quality is reported separately.

model_level_importance.label: spread relative to the bust threshold (spread / TRAIN Q90 error, m/m)

priority_formula.note: Product triage rule; weights are design choices, not fitted or validated constants.

attribution.method: TreeSHAP on the B2 booster (log-odds, before isotonic calibration)

drivers.label: spread relative to the bust threshold (spread / TRAIN Q90 error, m/m)

attribution.note: TreeSHAP contributions of the B2 booster (log-odds, before isotonic calibration). B2 sees only spread, spread percentile, spread/threshold ratio, lead day, region, season and init hour; the other evidence items are context, not model inputs.

evidence.text: Z500 ensemble spread 7.1 m = 99th percentile of training spread for this region, lead day and season; member anomaly-sign agreement 100%.
Forecast Z500 anomaly -151 m (|anomaly| at the 100th training percentile); pattern distance from the training mean 5.02 (PC units).

Of the 30 most similar verified historical forecast states for this region and lead day (1480 verified cases available; 0 within the similarity radius), 20% exceeded the bust threshold (climatological rate 10%).
Previous-cycle forecast for the same valid time not available in the downloaded archive.
Over the 5 days before initialisation, verified Day 1-3 forecasts for this region had mean normalized error 0.08 (mean error -4.4 m; 7% busts, n = 14); neighbouring regions 0.08, whole domain 0.15.
B2 bust probability 22.0% vs climatological rate B0 10.1% for this region, lead day and season (+11.9 percentage points).

interpretation: Bust probability 22.0% (raw model 21.2%): the estimated chance that this region-day's Z500 forecast error exceeds the project bust threshold (training Q90).
At or above the alert threshold 13.9% (10% false-alarm rate on validation).
Ensemble spread is at the 99th percentile of training spread for this region, lead day and season; B2 uses spread, its percentile and its ratio to the bust threshold, plus lead/region/season.
Historical analogue evidence (verified similar forecast states, not a model input): ELEVATED.

Inputs pushing the risk up for this case (TreeSHAP, associations not causes): spread percentile vs training (same region/lead/season), spread relative to the bust threshold (spread / TRAIN Q90 error, m/m), season.

analogue_summary.rule: same region and lead day; verified (valid_time) no later than this initialisation

context_features.label: pattern distance from training mean (PC space)
recent verified normalized error, this region (5 d)

reveal.reference: ERA5 (verification reference analysis; not perfect truth)

comparison.note: The expected signature is evaluated against the actual fingerprint only when the region-day verified as a bust.

memory_update.note: Verified outcomes become analogue candidates for initialisations at or after their valid time (causal memory). The persisted research store already contains them; nothing is re-trained.
